g.text: Exact purchased boards • component side up • XIAO USB-C at top • 5 V USB power
XIAO IS CENTERED: trace each W-number from an exact XIAO pin to one exact module hole. Every colored path = one jumper.
Sensor LEFT · holes RIGHT · labels top→bottom
ROTATED 90° CCW · sensor edge LEFT · holes RIGHT · order top→bottom: SDA / SCL / VDD / GND
ROTATED 90° CCW · holes RIGHT · order top→bottom: SDA / SCL / GND / 3Vo / VIN
USB-C ↑ TOP · antenna ↓ BOTTOM · do not mirror
LEFT ROW USED → D4/SDA · D5/SCL · D6/TX
RIGHT ROW USED → VBUS/5V · GND · 3V3 · D7/RX
If headers are installed, connect to the header pin—or to any breadboard hole in the same
numbered row on that same side of the center groove.
Colored ring = connect · gray = no wire · USB-C and antenna end shown
Breakout labels—not ribbon colors—define VCC / GND / RXD / TXD. SET, RESET and NC stay
16 SEPARATE JUMPER WIRES — POINT TO POINT
Match W-number + printed labels; drawing colors are identifiers.
• Every colored path is one physical jumper wire; no line represents a hidden multi-wire bus.
• PMS5003 keyed cable stays intact. On the red breakout, follow VCC/GND/RXD/TXD silkscreen—not ribbon colors.
• Leave BME680 SDO/CS, VEML7700 3Vo, and PMS SET/RESET/NC holes empty. PMS power is VBUS/5V, never 3V3.
Exact purchase references: B0DJ6N55FX · B0GXHGYRN2 · B0C622SS34 · B09KGYF83T · B0BG612GB2 · B0BHZTCK8J · B0BPXKJSWY · B0B2MMYZPL
